Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: P.E. Schultz <schultzporky@aol.com>
Sent: Saturday, September 16, 2017 8:46 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Trade Miggy? 
 
I'm sure you see my mail and think oh ------ its the kook from Muskegon again but got a topic for you. Sitting a game today my wife and I got talking about it. A month ago I would have said no freaking way. Today we are in a major overall rebuild. Like the wife said, "If Mig wants out why not oblige him". We ciuld maybe pick up couple more quality young pieces, we have couple guys who can play first, he is 34 and if he wants out we owe it to him. 
By the way Nick looks pretty damn good replacing JD in right doesn't he.
Go Blue!
Schultz
